description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a ServiceNow table via the Table API. Search-then-write (ServiceNow has no native upsert) — GET by `key_field=<value>` → PATCH existing row or POST new row. In-run cache prevents double-post on eventual-consistency lag.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one ServiceNow record (upserted by matching on `key_field`).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data — the write side effect lands in ServiceNow.

table.label: ServiceNow Table
table.description: Target table name (e.g. incident, change_request, cmdb_ci_server).

key_field.label: Key Field
key_field.description: ServiceNow field used to match existing rows (must be present in fields_map values).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: ServiceNow Record Upsert
